heading: INT. ORBITAL ALGAE FARM - MAIN BAY - CONTINUOUS

units.text: INT. ORBITAL ALGAE FARM - MAIN BAY - CONTINUOUS
A cylindrical chamber forty meters long, lined with transparent tubes of glowing green algae that pulse with the station's slow rotation.
The air smells of wet leaves and ozone.
Catwalks cross overhead.
CAPTAIN YARA OKONJO (40s, grey flight suit, braided hair, a data slate strapped to her forearm) walks the central catwalk with TECH BOONE (30s, grease-stained coveralls, wild beard).
DR. SELVAM (60s, white lab coat, thick spectacles) is on his knees at the base of a tube, scraping a sample from a cracked seal.
ARI (teen, apprentice, oversized hood, bare feet) crouches next to him, holding a petri dish.
In the control booth at the far end, PILOT KESTREL (30s, flight jacket, mirror shades pushed up on her head) leans on a console, feet on the desk.
OLU (50s, station cook, apron, a ladle in his hand) stands under the first tube and peers up.
Boone, give me the pressure.
units.name: YARA

units.text: Eleven-oh. Holding.
units.name: BOONE

units.text: The seals?
units.name: YARA

units.text: Doc says the third one's cracked.
units.name: BOONE

units.text: It's not cracked, it's weeping. There is a difference.
units.name: SELVAM

units.text: There is no difference when it's my kitchen being flooded with green soup.
units.name: OLU

units.text: Doctor, the sample's turning yellow.
units.name: ARI

units.text: Selvam snatches the dish, holds it to the light, and nods.
Contamination. Not severe.
units.name: SELVAM

units.text: Define not severe.
units.name: YARA

units.text: We lose perhaps ten percent of the bay.
units.name: SELVAM

units.text: Captain, supply drone is two minutes out. Do I hold it?
units.name: KESTREL

units.text: Hold it. Boone, shut the third line.
units.name: YARA

units.text: Boone climbs down a rungs ladder, wrench in hand, moves to a manifold and cranks a valve.
The glowing green in the third tube dims to dark.
Ari scrambles to hold a bucket under the dripping seal.
Olu walks up with his ladle and stirs the bucket thoughtfully.
This is going to be an awful dinner.
units.name: OLU

units.text: It will be a nutritious dinner.
units.name: SELVAM

units.text: Doctor, can the rest of the bay survive?
units.name: YARA

units.text: Without the third line, yes. For six days.
units.name: SELVAM

units.text: Then we have six days.
units.name: YARA

units.text: She taps her slate.
The station hums.
Overhead, the tubes pulse green in unison, and every one of them keeps living.
